thread:
Maya: Huge shoutout to @Devin and the ops crew for the surprise snack drop — sunflower seeds and iced oat milk saved my afternoon demo. :sunflower: :coffee:
Sam: omg that was so needed. developers deserve snacks. :raised_hands:
Devin: glad it landed at the right moment! Shoutout to the logistics elves (Jin + Priya) who helped coordinate the drop. :package:
Jin: we may have created a new tradition. who votes monthly 'snack champion' rotation? react with :seedling: for yes, :shrug: for no
Priya: I voted! also labelling seed jars with model names was peak ops lore. 😂
Maya: can we also start a tiny 'thank you' note jar for people who help with last-minute demos? quick Q: should notes be physical or a #kudos thread? (vote below)
Sam: digital kudos is fine but physical sticky notes = very wholesome.
Devin: agree with Sam. tiny notes win. adding: If anyone wants to sponsor snacks next month, I'll start a signup sheet. @ops-bot can you create a poll?
ops-bot: poll created — 'Snack Champion rotation: Monthly or Quarterly?' Options: Monthly, Quarterly, No preference. Link: https://polls.internal/redwood/snack-rotation-1
Maya: thanks! And huge thanks again to everyone who helped tonight. :sparkles:
